headerDisplay:
**Unofficial.** This plugin re-implements the REST side of the Intratone / Cogelec app so you can open your doors and gates from HomeKit, Matter and home automation — for people who want to stop using the app.

⚠️ **For normal use on a phone, the official Intratone app remains the best option.** It keeps every feature of your accesses — video door entry, calls, visitor codes, history — which this plugin does not: it only does remote opening.

Run it as a **child bridge**: set your account **phone number**, then **claim the door key** (Intratone texts a code). Claiming is required for Homebridge's own device — 4G (mobipass) doors open from one device at a time, so it removes remote opening from the phone that holds the key now. Advanced: set **Device ID** to your phone's (from a capture) to share its key instead.

app_id.title: App ID
app_id.description: Identifies the official app, not your account. Leave empty to use the iOS app's id shown here; set it only for another app.

app_token.title: App token
app_token.description: Built in for the iOS app, so this is empty by design — leave it blank to use the shipped token. Set it only to override it (if it stops working) or with the Android identity.

tel.title: Phone number
tel.description: Phone number tied to the Intratone account, e.g. 0612345678.

device_id.title: Device ID
device_id.description: Leave empty to generate one and keep it forever. To reuse an existing phone's registration, paste its device_id (found in its JWT).

service.title: HomeKit service
service.description: How each door appears in HomeKit. Over Matter every door is a door lock.

pulse_seconds.title: Pulse duration (s)
pulse_seconds.description: How long the door shows as unlocked/open after a successful command. 30 s suits an exterior gate.

access_refresh_minutes.title: Access list refresh (min)
access_refresh_minutes.description: How often the list of doors is re-fetched to add or remove accessories.

app_version.title: App version sent to the server

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Logs request/response bodies (tokens masked) at info level.

access_names.title: Rename doors
access_names.description: Give a door your own HomeKit name. Match it by access id — the log prints one per door ("Adding … access <id> …"), and the settings screen lists the detected doors here. Leave a name blank to keep the detected one.
